New York: Phillips calls its December sale its highest-value US watch auction ever, led by a rare pink gold Patek Philippe estimated above $3 million.

The New York Watch Auction: XV runs Dec. 5-6 at Phillips' gallery. The lead lot, a second-series Ref. 2499, is one of eight known in pink gold. Jerry Seinfeld is consigning his Vic Elford Rolex Daytona.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
